name: Trued, Relit
tagline: The family's week as a signal box's lit track diagram, the light back where the phosphor is: a lit greeting board with a steel branch of starters, plates the tube's height, and a timetable margin on every list.
concept: Trued, Relit keeps Trued's system (a line starts at a terminus and ends at a T buffer beside the way on; 'here' is a latched cell; the tube is the main line's first lamp, hung below Coming up's rail as stop one's plate) and puts the tube's light back on the greeting in the diagram's own terms. The greeting is its own lit board: E7's pool rises from the lower left behind a fine raster, the box rests in E4's halo and lights #6dff9c while written in, 'plan' carries E1 with a hot core, her screen breathes, and the ways to start are a short steel branch off the box whose junction lights while you write. Below, everything with a job is grounded: ink plates the tube's height with sunk readout wells, a timetable margin of dates on To do, a month that opens on now and runs on past its edge. It should feel like a calm signal box at night with one lamp lit where you are about to act.
companions: Steel #9cc3dd is the wiring and the family's hand: rails, the starter branch and its stop rings, the setup steps' stops and the form's required lamps at rest, links, the latched caps. Ink #1b2531 is a plan's plate wherever a plan is drawn (Home's plates and the month's cells alike), with a 2px cyan #74e6f0 cap; its time sits in a #080c0d sunk well. Slate keys #1b242b are the ways to start. Kind rings keep grounded hues (terracotta restaurants, moss outings, wheat seasons, lemon, lilac, pink, cyan). Amber means late or needs a look and nothing else: the late words, the half lamps (Status, Settings, each with its words), and the warning ring on Finish setting up. #6dff9c is the signature, lit only where attention belongs: the mark, Send, 'plan', the box's frame while written in, the junction lamp, the next setup step, a required field once filled, focus rings (selects included), now lamps and runs, working lamps, the tubes, and the 2px afterglow edge of a pointed row.
decisions: Title kept: 'What’s the *plan*?' (the box's <label>, Home's largest head, 'plan' the one lit word, at the line's end). Trued's own title, favoured across the tour's notes; nothing else on the screen glows 'plan', and the branch of starters beside it reads as answers to it.

The branch leaves the box at the question's height, not the From row the brief named: leaving at the From row puts the three keys below the box and pushes Coming up's tube off the 1280x900 first screen. At the question, the branch, its junction 'Or start with' and three slate keys stand level with the box, ending at a buffer by Send, and the whole Coming up line stays on the first screen. One 45-degree chamfer, 12px steel rings, spurs, a T buffer; the junction ring lights #6dff9c (E21) and the run from the box lights while the box has focus; a pointed key lights its stop and takes the afterglow edge. On the phone the keys stack under the box and the branch drops from its foot.

Greeting light: E7 pool at 0.16 from the lower left reaching under the box's foot, masked 2px/6% scanlines inside it only; E4 resting halo (1px brand 35%, 28px -6px brand 25%), on focus the frame #6dff9c with a ring and 36px bloom; E1 on 'plan' plus a 1px hot core, and Send's pool calmed slightly so 'plan' is the brightest thing on the board; her screen breathes (E19 halo, 3.2s).
Head figures on one line on the head's baseline, 15px ink-2 with a steel middle dot: '4 coming · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00', '12 ideas · 10 on the line', '4 open · 3 late', under the head on the phone.

Plates the tube's height (tube 20rem, plates 1fr): kind ring in its grounded colour and the kind word, the name in Archivo 15px, two balanced lines at most (a 44px link), whom it is for with a person glyph, and at the foot a sunk well (#080c0d, inset shadow) with the time in DM Mono tabular and 'in 7 days' in sans. Ink #1b2531 with the 2px cyan cap. The kind and whom are read in the template from the ideas table (read-only), because views.entry_row does not carry them.
The tube's prompt line is the link '› 3 more on the line▮'; E16 power-on kept with a 0.1s delay.

To do, page and Home: the margin timetable is back with the deadline as 'Sun 27 Sep 19:56', right-aligned tabular DM Mono; the relative words are amber in the page's When column and under each title on Home; the boxed Edit keys are a quiet underlined 'Edit' with a 44px target. The NOW rule stays.

Plans month: the head counts what this grid holds ('4 more in October · next Sun 4 Oct 13:00') so it never disagrees with the drawing; weekends a slate step lighter; empty past weeks fold to a 32px dashed-steel strip; under the last week a turnout leaves the rail with one 45-degree turn to a T buffer labelled 'November continues · Later →', the pager's own link.

Ideas: the list comes first; the line from home moved below the table, its nearest and furthest printed as links on the glass above the line ('Nearest Pumpkin patch, 18 min · Furthest Cannon Beach, 2 h 45') so no label meets a tick; a station lights on a row's hover or focus.
Status: This page (still on the installer's password) is an amber half lamp, read the same way Settings reads it; the tally says '5 working · 1 waiting · 1 needs a look · 2 off · 4 not set up'.
Chat: title 3rem, the lede on one line, tighter date strip and thread; From and Send are on the 1280x900 first screen.

Afterglow (E9): every steel or sage row wash replaced by a 2px #6dff9c left edge over a 10% wash, in at 0.12s and out over 1.2s, on plates, starter keys, Ideas rows, Lately rows, To do rows, Status rows and Settings rows.
Selects take the same 2px #6dff9c ring and bloom as fields; the New idea form's rail gets a stop at 'Everything else' (filled steel when open).
Phone: Send shows its word; the box's foot is two rows (who is asking and the mic; where I am and Send).

Second pass, the plates: the name is the plate's headline (Archivo 21px, balanced, three lines at most) and the plate is two blocks, kind and name at its head, whom it is for over the sunk well at its foot, so the height between them is margin, not an empty slot. The plate's date is spoken in the well for screen readers only: the board above the rail already shows it, so printing it twice was declined.

Amber has one meaning again: setup stops are steel rings (the next step lit #6dff9c, a done step sage), the setup panel's edge is the plain line, the form's required lamps are steel rings that light #6dff9c once the field is valid; every half-lamp row on Settings prints 'Needs a look'.

One head-figure rule everywhere: the count in 15px semibold heading ink, its words in 15px ink-2, on the title's baseline (Plans, Ideas, To do, Wishes and every section head); no display numeral beside a title. Ideas reads '12 in all · 10 on the line', its No. column bare numbers.

Status: the tally is the legend (lamp, figure, word for every kind of lamp, a kind with none printed quieter, its lamp unlit), so the separate legend line went; the Connected bank's digest lamp is named 'Weekly' so it no longer repeats Who answers' 'Digest'.
The month's plans wear the family's plate (ink, cyan cap, the time in its sunk well on its own line); a plan gone by keeps a dimmed plate with a spent-cyan cap.

Home's first screen at 1280x900 closes Coming up (its board ends at 822px): the greeting's padding is trimmed, and the branch's buffer stands on the box's foot line. On the phone the box's foot is one row of who, mic and Send with 'Send where I am' under it, the starters are single-line 15px keys, and the now lamp and Next up's tube enter above the tab bar.
strengths: The top of Home is lit again, and the light is content: the pool and raster behind the box, the halo on its frame, 'plan' the brightest word, and a lamp at the starters' junction that comes on while you write.
The ways to start now speak the track language (a branch, a junction, stops, a buffer) and read as keys, not fields.
Coming up is one finished diagram on the first screen: the tube as stop one and three ink plates of the same height whose feet align with the tube, with no wrapped names and no dead slate.
One timetable rule across Home, To do and Plans: absolute dates in a right-aligned tabular margin, how far off in words beside, amber only for late; the month opens on now and runs on past its edge.

Faults the judges named are fixed: the lying lamp on Status, Send below the fold on Chat, colliding labels on Ideas, stacked 12px head labels, heavy Edit keys, the empty '›▮' line, the invisible row afterglow, the unringed select; 0 targets under 44px and nothing under 13px on every page, desktop and phone.
weaknesses: Still line-heavy: a judge who reads rails as a subway map finds one on nearly every page, the greeting included.

More values are worked out in templates: the plates' kind and whom and Home's absolute deadlines are read-only SQL in home.html, beside the month figures and Status signals. Each belongs in views.py (entry_row: kind, who; task_brief: due date and hour).
The branch leaves the box at the question, not at the From row the first brief asked for, to keep Coming up on the first screen.
A plate's name balances by length, so 'Mount St. / Helens day trip' breaks inside a proper name.
On the phone the select's chevron sits close to 'who is asking?'; the Google note still takes two lines before the line starts.

Words differ from today's by up to 30% on Ideas (the line from home's words, '12 in all'), and Home adds 'Or start with', the plates' kinds and '3 more on the line'; Status's lamp under Connected now says 'Weekly'.
revisions: Plates: name raised from 15px to 21px Archivo (balanced, three lines max), whom moved to the plate's foot above the well, so the plate reads as head and foot instead of a name over 90px of air; the date went into the well as screen-reader text only (declined printing it: the board above the rail already says it).
Reading order: the 'All plans' buffer now follows the last plate in the DOM.

Amber: setup stops steel with the next step lit and the panel edge neutral; .req-lamp a steel ring filling #6dff9c on :valid; Settings prints 'Needs a look' on every half-lamp row (Messages included).

Home To do: dropped the floating 'Due' head (the dates speak for themselves on Home, the To do page keeps its Who/When/Due heads); the margin dates on both are set in the sans with tabular figures at letter-spacing 0, no longer spaced mono.

First screen: greeting padding trimmed (2rem to 1.5rem/1.35rem) and its margin cut; the branch's padding removed so its buffer ends level with the box's foot; Coming up now closes at 822px on 1280x900.

Plans month: .event now the ink plate with the 2px cyan cap and a mono time in a sunk well on its own line; past plans dimmed. Every page head's figure is the 15px line with the count bold in heading ink (the display numerals went).

Ideas: figure '12 in all · 10 on the line' (no repeated 'ideas'); '#' dropped from the No. column; afterglow wash cut from 10% to 6% everywhere so a pointed row never reads as selected (the 2px edge and the 1.2s fade stay).

Status: legend folded into the tally (lamp, figure, word, with 'off, by choice' and 'stopped' as the extra kinds; zero kinds quieter, lamp unlit); tally figures 32px; Connected's 'Digest' renamed 'Weekly'; bank lamps held at 12px.

Phone: who, mic and Send on one row (the select's padding trimmed so 'who is asking?' fits), 'Send where I am' under it; starter keys single-line 15px; tighter greeting and Coming up head, so the now lamp and the tube's top show above the tab bar. Chat's date on the rail is 14px sans ink-2 between its ticks, no boxed mono.
Declined: shortening the tube to 15rem (the plates now use the tube's height, and the tube's radar needs its width).
